---- MODULE W4Od9m4p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Regions, Amounts, Cap, QMax

Cmds == [reg: Regions, amt: Amounts]
LoadMax == Cap + 2

VARIABLES pending, load, shed, processed
vars == <<pending, load, shed, processed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ pending \subseteq Cmds
  /\ load \in 0..LoadMax
  /\ shed \subseteq Regions
  /\ processed \subseteq Cmds

Init ==
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ load = 0
  /\ shed = {}
  /\ processed = {}

\* A regional controller enqueues a command; backpressure bounds the queue.
Submit(c) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < QMax
  /\ c \notin pending
  /\ c \notin processed
  /\ pending' = pending \union {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, shed, processed>>

\* Any pending command may be applied (reordering) if capacity allows.
Commit(c) ==
  /\ c \in pending
  /\ load + c.amt <= Cap
  /\ load' = load + c.amt
  /\ processed' = processed \union {c}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED shed

\* A command that would overflow capacity is dropped from the queue.
Reject(c) ==
  /\ c \in pending
  /\ load + c.amt > Cap
  /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, shed, processed>>

\* Shedding a region lowers committed load and marks it permanently.
Shed(r) ==
  /\ r \notin shed
  /\ load >= 1
  /\ load' = load - 1
  /\ shed' = shed \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, processed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cmds: Submit(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cmds: Commit(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cmds: Reject(c)
  \/ \E r \in Regions: Shed(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK == load <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Regions = {r1, r2}
  Amounts = {1, 2}
  Cap = 3
  QMax = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapOK
nl:
A power-grid load shedder governs how much demand the grid commits to serve. The grid has a fixed capacity Cap. Regional controllers submit serve commands into a bounded work queue; because the network reorders messages, the queue is an unordered set and pending commands may be applied in any order. Backpressure keeps the queue from ever holding more than QMax pending commands. When a command is committed, its requested amount is added to the committed load only if the resulting total would not exceed capacity. A command whose amount would overflow capacity is rejected and dropped from the queue. A region may be shed, which lowers the committed load by one unit and permanently marks that region as shed.

Actions: Submit (enqueue a command under backpressure, never re-enqueuing an already-committed command), Commit (apply any one pending command when capacity allows and record it as processed), Reject (drop a pending command that would overflow capacity), Shed (lower the committed load and permanently mark a region as shed).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the committed load never exceeds the grid capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od17m2p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Participants, Total, Batch

Votes == {"none", "yes", "no"}

VARIABLES src, moving, dlv, vote, crashed
vars == <<src, moving, dlv, vote, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ src \in 0..Total
  /\ moving \in 0..Total
  /\ dlv \in 0..Total
  /\ vote \in [Participants -> Votes]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Participants

Init ==
  /\ src = Total
  /\ moving = 0
  /\ dlv = 0
  /\ vote = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ crashed = {}

\* Coordinator escrows a batch out of the source and opens a 2PC round.
Prepare(n) ==
  /\ moving = 0
  /\ n \in 1..Batch
  /\ src >= n
  /\ src' = src - n
  /\ moving' = n
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dlv, crashed>>

\* A live participant casts its vote in the current round.
Vote(p, v) ==
  /\ moving > 0
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ vote[p] = "none"
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<src, moving, dlv, crashed>>

\* A participant crashes silently without voting.
Crash(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \union {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<src, moving, dlv, vote>>

\* All still-live participants voted yes: the escrowed bags are delivered.
Commit ==
  /\ moving > 0
  /\ \A p \in Participants : p \in crashed \/ vote[p] = "yes"
  /\ \E p \in Participants : p \notin crashed
  /\ dlv' = dlv + moving
  /\ moving' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<src, vote, crashed>>

\* A no-vote or a crash aborts the round; escrowed bags return to source.
Abort ==
  /\ moving > 0
  /\ \E p \in Participants : vote[p] = "no" \/ p \in crashed
  /\ src' = src + moving
  /\ moving' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dlv, vote, crashed>>

\* A delivered bag is recirculated back to the source for re-routing.
Recirculate ==
  /\ moving = 0
  /\ dlv > 0
  /\ dlv' = dlv - 1
  /\ src' = src + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<moving, vote, crashed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in 1..Batch : Prepare(n)
  \/ \E p \in Participants, v \in Votes : Vote(p, v)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Recirculate

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserve == src + moving + dlv = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Participants = {p1, p2}
  Total = 3
  Batch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserve
nl:
An airport baggage router moves bags from a source hopper to delivery using two-phase commit across participant belts. Bags are never created or destroyed: every bag is at the source, escrowed in an in-flight transfer, or delivered. A coordinator escrows a batch of bags out of the source and opens a commit round, clearing all votes. Each live participant votes yes or no. A participant may crash silently, casting no vote at all. When every still-live participant has voted yes and at least one participant is still live, the round commits and the escrowed bags are delivered. If any participant votes no or has crashed, the round aborts and the escrowed bags are returned to the source. A delivered bag may be recirculated back to the source for re-routing.

Actions: Prepare (escrow a batch from the source and open a round), Vote (a live participant votes yes or no), Crash (a participant crashes silently), Commit (deliver the escrowed batch when all live participants voted yes), Abort (return the escrowed batch to the source on any no-vote or crash), Recirculate (move one delivered bag back to the source).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of bags across the source, in-flight escrow, and delivery is always exactly the amount the system started with.

---- MODULE W4Od12m9p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Slots, Holders, MaxEpoch, MaxPend

Reqs == [slot: Slots, who: Holders, ep: 0..MaxEpoch]

VARIABLES grants, epoch, pending, released
vars == <<grants, epoch, pending, released>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ grants \subseteq [slot: Slots, who: Holders]
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ pending \subseteq Reqs
  /\ released \subseteq Slots

Init ==
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ released = {}

\* A requester submits a claim stamped with the epoch it believes is current.
Request(s, w) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < MaxPend
  /\ LET rq == [slot |-> s, who |-> w, ep |-> epoch] IN
       /\ rq \notin pending
       /\ pending' = pending \union {rq}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, epoch, released>>

\* The pool is reconfigured, advancing the epoch and staling old claims.
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, pending, released>>

\* A current-epoch claim for a free slot is granted (claims may be reordered).
Grant(rq) ==
  /\ rq \in pending
  /\ rq.ep = epoch
  /\ \A g \in grants : g.slot # rq.slot
  /\ grants' = grants \union {[slot |-> rq.slot, who |-> rq.who]}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {rq}
  /\ released' = released \ {rq.slot}
  /\ UNCHANGED epoch

\* A stale (old-epoch) claim left over from before a reconfiguration is dropped.
DropStale(rq) ==
  /\ rq \in pending
  /\ rq.ep < epoch
  /\ pending' = pending \ {rq}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, epoch, released>>

\* A holder releases its slot, freeing it for a future grant.
Release(g) ==
  /\ g \in grants
  /\ grants' = grants \ {g}
  /\ released' = released \union {g.slot}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Slots, w \in Holders : Request(s, w)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E rq \in Reqs : Grant(rq)
  \/ \E rq \in Reqs : DropStale(rq)
  \/ \E g \in grants : Release(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A g1, g2 \in grants : g1.slot = g2.slot => g1.who = g2.who
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Slots = {s1, s2}
  Holders = {h1, h2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  MaxPend = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker allocates storage slots to holders across epoch-numbered reconfigurations of the pool. Each claim message a requester submits is stamped with the epoch the requester believes is current, and because messages can be reordered, claims may be granted in any order and old claims may linger after a reconfiguration. When the pool is reconfigured, the current epoch advances, staling every claim stamped with an earlier epoch. A current-epoch claim for a slot that no holder currently owns is granted, recording the slot-holder pair; the slot is removed from the released set. A stale claim carrying an epoch older than the current one is dropped without effect. A holder may release its slot, freeing it for a later grant.

Actions: Request (submit an epoch-stamped claim, bounded by queue capacity), Reconfigure (advance the epoch, staling older claims), Grant (award a free slot to a current-epoch claim), DropStale (discard a claim from an older epoch), Release (a holder gives up its slot).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no storage slot is ever allocated to two different holders at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od5m0p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Slots, Players, Instances, MaxVer, MaxAtt

Attempts == [slot: Slots, who: Players, seen: 0..MaxVer, inst: Instances]

VARIABLES occupant, ver, members, attempts
vars == <<occupant, ver, members, attempts>>

Free == "free"

TypeOK ==
  /\ occupant \in [Slots -> Players \union {Free}]
  /\ ver \in [Slots -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ members \subseteq Players
  /\ attempts \subseteq Attempts

Init ==
  /\ occupant = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
  /\ ver = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
  /\ members = {}
  /\ attempts = {}

\* A player is admitted to the lobby, becoming an authorized participant.
Join(p) ==
  /\ p \notin members
  /\ members' = members \union {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, ver, attempts>>

\* An instance optimistically proposes to seat a player, recording the
\* slot version it observed so a later commit can detect interference.
Attempt(s, p, i) ==
  /\ Cardinality(attempts) < MaxAtt
  /\ p \in members
  /\ attempts' = attempts \union {[slot |-> s, who |-> p, seen |-> ver[s], inst |-> i]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, ver, members>>

\* The optimistic write commits only if the version is unchanged, the slot
\* is free, and the writer is still an authorized member.
Commit(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ ver[a.slot] = a.seen
  /\ occupant[a.slot] = Free
  /\ a.who \in members
  /\ ver[a.slot] < MaxVer
  /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![a.slot] = a.who]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![a.slot] = ver[a.slot] + 1]
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED members

\* An attempt that lost the optimistic race is dropped and would be retried.
Retry(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ \/ ver[a.slot] # a.seen
     \/ occupant[a.slot] # Free
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, ver, members>>

\* A seated player leaves its slot, advancing the version.
Vacate(s) ==
  /\ occupant[s] # Free
  /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
  /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = ver[s] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<members, attempts>>

\* Authorization is revoked; the player is evicted from any slot it holds.
Revoke(p) ==
  /\ p \in members
  /\ members' = members \ {p}
  /\ occupant' = [s \in Slots |-> IF occupant[s] = p THEN Free ELSE occupant[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, attempts>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Players : Join(p)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, p \in Players, i \in Instances : Attempt(s, p, i)
  \/ \E a \in Attempts : Commit(a)
  \/ \E a \in Attempts : Retry(a)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : Vacate(s)
  \/ \E p \in Players : Revoke(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyAuthorizedSeated ==
  \A s \in Slots : occupant[s] # Free => occupant[s] \in members
====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats authorized players into match slots. Two independent matchmaker instances share one pool of slots and coordinate through optimistic locking: each slot carries a version number, and a write succeeds only if the version the writer observed still matches at commit time, otherwise the write is retried. A player must first join the lobby to become an authorized participant. An instance optimistically proposes to seat a player in a slot, recording the version it observed. The proposal commits only if the slot's version is unchanged, the slot is still free, and the proposer is still an authorized member; committing seats the player and advances the version. A proposal that lost the race — because the version changed or the slot filled — is dropped and would be retried. A seated player may vacate its slot, advancing the version. Authorization may be revoked, which immediately evicts that player from any slot it holds.

Actions: Join (admit a player as authorized), Attempt (optimistically propose a seating, recording the observed version), Commit (apply the write if version, freeness, and authorization all still hold), Retry (drop a proposal that lost the optimistic race), Vacate (a seated player leaves, advancing the version), Revoke (revoke authorization and evict the player).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every occupied slot is held by a currently authorized player, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever holds a seat.

---- MODULE W4Od15m9p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Orders, Slots, MaxEpoch, MaxPend

None == "none"
Props == [ord: Orders, slot: Slots, ep: 0..MaxEpoch]

VARIABLES holder, assignedTo, epoch, pending, cancelled
vars == <<holder, assignedTo, epoch, pending, cancelled>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in [Slots -> Orders \union {None}]
  /\ assignedTo \in [Orders -> Slots \union {None}]
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ pending \subseteq Props
  /\ cancelled \subseteq Orders

Init ==
  /\ holder = [s \in Slots |-> None]
  /\ assignedTo = [o \in Orders |-> None]
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ cancelled = {}

\* A (possibly slow) participant proposes to place an order at a price slot.
Propose(o, s) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < MaxPend
  /\ assignedTo[o] = None
  /\ o \notin cancelled
  /\ pending' = pending \union {[ord |-> o, slot |-> s, ep |-> epoch]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, assignedTo, epoch, cancelled>>

\* A proposal is filled iff both the slot and the order are still unbound.
Assign(rq) ==
  /\ rq \in pending
  /\ holder[rq.slot] = None
  /\ assignedTo[rq.ord] = None
  /\ rq.ord \notin cancelled
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![rq.slot] = rq.ord]
  /\ assignedTo' = [assignedTo EXCEPT ![rq.ord] = rq.slot]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {rq}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cancelled>>

\* The auction is reconfigured into a new round, discarding stale proposals.
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ pending' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, assignedTo, cancelled>>

\* A slow participant eventually withdraws its order, freeing the slot.
Withdraw(o) ==
  /\ assignedTo[o] # None
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![assignedTo[o]] = None]
  /\ assignedTo' = [assignedTo EXCEPT ![o] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pending, cancelled>>

\* An unassigned order is cancelled before the fill.
Cancel(o) ==
  /\ o \notin cancelled
  /\ assignedTo[o] = None
  /\ cancelled' = cancelled \union {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, assignedTo, epoch, pending>>

\* A cancelled order is restored to the book.
Restore(o) ==
  /\ o \in cancelled
  /\ cancelled' = cancelled \ {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, assignedTo, epoch, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Orders, s \in Slots : Propose(o, s)
  \/ \E rq \in Props : Assign(rq)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Withdraw(o)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Cancel(o)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Restore(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FillCoherent ==
  \A o \in Orders : assignedTo[o] # None => holder[assignedTo[o]] = o
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Orders = {o1, o2}
  Slots = {s1, s2}
  MaxEpoch = 1
  MaxPend = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FillCoherent
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction assigns orders to price-level slots across epoch-numbered reconfigurations of the auction book. Participants may be slow but never fail: a lagging participant's proposal is still valid and will eventually be acted on, though a reconfiguration into a new round discards proposals that did not fill in time. Each order tracks the slot it occupies, and each slot tracks the order that holds it. A participant proposes placing an unbound, uncancelled order at a slot. A proposal is filled only when both the target slot and the order are still unbound, binding them together as back-pointers. When the auction is reconfigured, the epoch advances and all still-pending proposals are cleared. A slow participant eventually withdraws its order, releasing its slot. An unassigned order may be cancelled before it fills, and a cancelled order may later be restored to the book.

Actions: Propose (a participant proposes an order-to-slot placement), Assign (fill a proposal when both order and slot are free, binding the two back-pointers), Reconfigure (advance the epoch and discard pending proposals), Withdraw (a slow participant releases its assigned slot), Cancel (remove an unassigned order from the book), Restore (return a cancelled order to the book).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever an order is recorded as holding a slot, that slot records the very same order as its holder, so no slot is ever double-allocated to two orders.

---- MODULE W4Od13m3p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Total

None == "none"

RECURSIVE FoldSum(_, _)
FoldSum(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET n == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN f[n] + FoldSum(f, S \ {n})

VARIABLES held, vault, transit, leader, up
vars == <<held, vault, transit, leader, up>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ held \in [Nodes -> 0..Total]
  /\ vault \in 0..Total
  /\ transit \in [Nodes -> 0..Total]
  /\ leader \in Nodes \union {None}
  /\ up \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
  /\ held = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
  /\ vault = Total
  /\ transit = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
  /\ leader = None
  /\ up = Nodes

\* A live machine with no standing leader is elected to coordinate dispatch.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \in up
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, vault, transit, up>>

\* The current leader fails; the network is left leaderless until failover.
Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ up' = up \ {n}
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, vault, transit>>

\* A downed machine recovers and rejoins the network.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \notin up
  /\ up' = up \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, vault, transit, leader>>

\* The leader dispatches a coin from the vault toward a machine.
Dispatch(n) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ vault > 0
  /\ vault' = vault - 1
  /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![n] = transit[n] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, leader, up>>

\* A dispatched coin is delivered to a live machine (deliveries reorder).
Deliver(n) ==
  /\ transit[n] > 0
  /\ n \in up
  /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![n] = transit[n] - 1]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![n] = held[n] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, leader, up>>

\* A machine returns one of its coins to the vault.
Return(n) ==
  /\ held[n] > 0
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![n] = held[n] - 1]
  /\ vault' = vault + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, leader, up>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Dispatch(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Deliver(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Return(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CoinsConserved ==
  FoldSum(held, Nodes) + vault + FoldSum(transit, Nodes) = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {n1, n2}
  Total = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CoinsConserved
nl:
A vending machine network circulates a fixed stock of coins between machines and a central vault, coordinated by an elected leader with failover. Every coin is always somewhere: held by a machine, sitting in the vault, or in transit as a dispatch message. Because the network reorders messages, dispatched coins may be delivered to their target machines in any order. A live machine with no standing leader may be elected coordinator. The current leader may fail, leaving the network leaderless until a new leader is elected; a downed machine may later recover and rejoin. The leader dispatches a coin out of the vault toward a machine, putting it in transit. A coin in transit to a live machine is eventually delivered into that machine's holdings. A machine may return one of its held coins to the vault.

Actions: Elect (a live machine with no leader becomes coordinator), Fail (the leader fails and the network becomes leaderless), Recover (a downed machine rejoins), Dispatch (the leader moves a coin from the vault into transit toward a machine), Deliver (a coin in transit arrives at a live machine, in any order), Return (a machine sends one held coin back to the vault).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of coins across all machines, the vault, and messages in transit is always exactly the fixed stock the network started with.

---- MODULE W4Od5m1p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Slots

Grant == [slot: Slots, node: Nodes]

VARIABLES token, held, want, slow
vars == <<token, held, want, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Nodes
  /\ held \subseteq Grant
  /\ want \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Slots]
  /\ slow \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
  /\ token \in Nodes
  /\ held = {}
  /\ want = [n \in Nodes |-> {}]
  /\ slow = {}

\* A node registers its interest in acquiring a slot.
Request(n, s) ==
  /\ s \notin want[n]
  /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![n] = want[n] \union {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, held, slow>>

\* The exclusive-access token advances to the next node in the ring.
PassToken(n) ==
  /\ token = n
  /\ token' \in {m \in Nodes : m # n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, want, slow>>

\* Only the token holder may grant, and only a slot no one already holds.
Acquire(n, s) ==
  /\ token = n
  /\ s \in want[n]
  /\ \A g \in held : g.slot # s
  /\ held' = held \union {[slot |-> s, node |-> n]}
  /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![n] = want[n] \ {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

\* A holder releases its slot, making it available again.
Release(n, s) ==
  /\ [slot |-> s, node |-> n] \in held
  /\ held' = held \ {[slot |-> s, node |-> n]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, want, slow>>

\* A node becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(n) ==
  /\ n \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, held, want>>

\* A slow node catches up and resumes normal speed.
Resume(n) ==
  /\ n \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, held, want>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Request(n, s)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : PassToken(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Acquire(n, s)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Release(n, s)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : MarkSlow(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Resume(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A g1, g2 \in held : g1.slot = g2.slot => g1.node = g2.node
====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker grants exclusive match slots using a token ring: an access token circulates around the ring of matchmaker nodes, and only the node currently holding the token may grant a slot. Nodes can be slow but never fail — a lagging node still eventually acts and still eventually receives the token. A node registers interest in a slot it would like to grant to itself. The token advances from its holder to the next node in the ring. Only the token holder may acquire a slot, and only a slot that no node already holds; acquiring records the slot-node grant and clears that request. A holder may release its slot, freeing it for a later grant. A node may become slow (lagging) and later resume normal speed, but it never fails.

Actions: Request (a node registers interest in a slot), PassToken (the exclusive-access token advances to the next ring node), Acquire (the token holder grants itself a slot no one else holds), Release (a holder frees its slot), MarkSlow (a node becomes lagging), Resume (a slow node catches back up).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot is ever held by two different matchmaker nodes at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od17m7p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Bags, Handlers, MaxLog

None == "none"

VARIABLES reg, owner, shipped, slow
vars == <<reg, owner, shipped, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Bags -> {"open", "locked", "loaded"}]
  /\ owner \in [Bags -> Handlers \union {None}]
  /\ shipped \in Seq(Bags)
  /\ slow \subseteq Handlers

Init ==
  /\ reg = [b \in Bags |-> "open"]
  /\ owner = [b \in Bags |-> None]
  /\ shipped = << >>
  /\ slow = {}

\* Compare-and-swap the register open -> locked, taking ownership of the bag.
Claim(b, h) ==
  /\ reg[b] = "open"
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![b] = "locked"]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = h]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<shipped, slow>>

\* Release a locked claim (reversible), swapping the register back to open.
Abandon(b, h) ==
  /\ reg[b] = "locked"
  /\ owner[b] = h
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![b] = "open"]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<shipped, slow>>

\* The irreversible load: swap locked -> loaded once, appending to the manifest.
Load(b, h) ==
  /\ reg[b] = "locked"
  /\ owner[b] = h
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![b] = "loaded"]
  /\ shipped' = Append(shipped, b)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, slow>>

\* A handler becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(h) ==
  /\ h \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {h}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, owner, shipped>>

\* A slow handler resumes normal speed.
Resume(h) ==
  /\ h \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {h}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, owner, shipped>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Bags, h \in Handlers : Claim(b, h)
  \/ \E b \in Bags, h \in Handlers : Abandon(b, h)
  \/ \E b \in Bags, h \in Handlers : Load(b, h)
  \/ \E h \in Handlers : MarkSlow(h)
  \/ \E h \in Handlers : Resume(h)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LenBound == Len(shipped) <= MaxLog

LoadedAtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN shipped : shipped[i] = shipped[j] => i = j

  Handlers = {h1, h2}

INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
An airport baggage router loads bags onto departing aircraft, an irreversible action that must happen at most once per bag. Each bag has a compare-and-swap register that moves open, locked, then loaded; handlers may be slow but never fail. A handler compare-and-swaps a bag's register from open to locked, taking ownership. While locked, the owning handler may abandon the claim, swapping the register back to open. The irreversible load swaps the register from locked to loaded exactly once and appends the bag to the departure manifest; once loaded, no further register transition is possible. A handler may become slow (lagging) and later resume, but it never fails.

---- MODULE W4Od9m0p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Regions, Controllers, MaxVer, MaxPend

Props == [region: Regions, who: Controllers, seen: 0..MaxVer]

VARIABLES ver, shedSet, dumped, crashed, pending
vars == <<ver, shedSet, dumped, crashed, pending>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in [Regions -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ shedSet \subseteq Regions
  /\ dumped \in 0..(Cardinality(Regions) + 1)
  /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers
  /\ pending \subseteq Props

Init ==
  /\ ver = [r \in Regions |-> 0]
  /\ shedSet = {}
  /\ dumped = 0
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ pending = {}

\* A live controller optimistically proposes shedding a region, recording
\* the version it observed so a stale proposal can be detected later.
Propose(r, p) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < MaxPend
  /\ r \notin shedSet
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ pending' = pending \union {[region |-> r, who |-> p, seen |-> ver[r]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, shedSet, dumped, crashed>>

\* A configuration bump advances a region's version, staling open proposals.
Bump(r) ==
  /\ r \notin shedSet
  /\ ver[r] < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = ver[r] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<shedSet, dumped, crashed, pending>>

\* The irreversible shed fires once: only for a not-yet-shed region whose
\* observed version still matches, and only by a still-live controller.
Commit(pr) ==
  /\ pr \in pending
  /\ pr.region \notin shedSet
  /\ ver[pr.region] = pr.seen
  /\ pr.who \notin crashed
  /\ shedSet' = shedSet \union {pr.region}
  /\ dumped' = dumped + 1
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![pr.region] = ver[pr.region] + 1]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {pr}
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* A proposal whose observed version is now stale is dropped and retried.
Retry(pr) ==
  /\ pr \in pending
  /\ ver[pr.region] # pr.seen
  /\ pending' = pending \ {pr}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, shedSet, dumped, crashed>>

\* At most one controller may be crashed (silently) at a time.
Crash(p) ==
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ crashed' = {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, shedSet, dumped, pending>>

\* The crashed controller restarts.
Restart(p) ==
  /\ p \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, shedSet, dumped, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Regions, p \in Controllers : Propose(r, p)
  \/ \E r \in Regions : Bump(r)
  \/ \E pr \in Props : Commit(pr)
  \/ \E pr \in Props : Retry(pr)
  \/ \E p \in Controllers : Crash(p)
  \/ \E p \in Controllers : Restart(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ShedOnce ==
  dumped = Cardinality(shedSet)
====

CONSTANTS
  Regions = {r1, r2}
  Controllers = {p1, p2}
  MaxVer = 2
  MaxPend = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ShedOnce
nl:
A power-grid load shedder irreversibly sheds overloaded regions, an action that must happen at most once per region. Controllers coordinate through optimistic locking with retry: each region carries a version, and a shed proposal records the version the proposer observed. One controller may crash silently at a time. A live controller proposes shedding a not-yet-shed region, stamping the proposal with the region's current version. A configuration bump may advance a region's version, staling any open proposals. The irreversible shed commits only for a region that has not already been shed, whose observed version still matches, proposed by a still-live controller; committing adds the region to the shed set, advances its version, and increments the running total of shed regions. A proposal whose observed version has gone stale is dropped and would be retried. At most one controller may be crashed at any moment; a crashed controller later restarts.

Actions: Propose (a live controller optimistically proposes a shed, recording the observed version), Bump (advance a region's version, staling open proposals), Commit (the irreversible shed, guarded by version match and no prior shed), Retry (drop a stale proposal), Crash (silently crash the single allowed controller), Restart (the crashed controller comes back).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the running count of irreversible sheds always equals the number of distinct shed regions, so no region is ever shed more than once.

---- MODULE W4Od19m8p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Shelves, Members, Cap

None == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, count, crashed
vars == <<coarse, fine, count, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in [Shelves -> Members \union {None}]
  /\ fine \in [Shelves -> Members \union {None}]
  /\ count \in [Shelves -> 0..(Cap + 1)]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Members

Init ==
  /\ coarse = [s \in Shelves |-> None]
  /\ fine = [s \in Shelves |-> None]
  /\ count = [s \in Shelves |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = {}

\* Take the coarse shelf lock first (the top of the lock hierarchy).
AcquireCoarse(sh, m) ==
  /\ coarse[sh] = None
  /\ m \notin crashed
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![sh] = m]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, count, crashed>>

\* Take the fine lock only while already holding the coarse lock.
AcquireFine(sh, m) ==
  /\ coarse[sh] = m
  /\ fine[sh] = None
  /\ m \notin crashed
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![sh] = m]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, count, crashed>>

\* Place a reservation only while holding both locks and under capacity.
Reserve(sh, m) ==
  /\ coarse[sh] = m
  /\ fine[sh] = m
  /\ count[sh] < Cap
  /\ count' = [count EXCEPT ![sh] = count[sh] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, crashed>>

\* Release both locks held by a member on a shelf, innermost first.
ReleaseLocks(sh, m) ==
  /\ coarse[sh] = m
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![sh] = None]
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![sh] = IF fine[sh] = m THEN None ELSE fine[sh]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<count, crashed>>

\* A patron cancels one reservation on a shelf.
Cancel(sh) ==
  /\ count[sh] > 0
  /\ count' = [count EXCEPT ![sh] = count[sh] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, crashed>>

\* One member crashes silently; its locks are reclaimed by the system.
Crash(m) ==
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ crashed' = {m}
  /\ coarse' = [s \in Shelves |-> IF coarse[s] = m THEN None ELSE coarse[s]]
  /\ fine' = [s \in Shelves |-> IF fine[s] = m THEN None ELSE fine[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED count

\* The crashed member recovers.
Recover(m) ==
  /\ m \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, count>>

Next ==
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : AcquireCoarse(sh, m)
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : AcquireFine(sh, m)
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : Reserve(sh, m)
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : ReleaseLocks(sh, m)
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves : Cancel(sh)
  \/ \E m \in Members : Crash(m)
  \/ \E m \in Members : Recover(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityOK ==
  \A sh \in Shelves : count[sh] <= Cap
====

CONSTANTS
  Shelves = {sh1, sh2}
  Members = {m1, m2}
  Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl:
A library book reservation system limits how many reservations sit on each shelf, protecting the shelf with a hierarchy of locks acquired coarse-then-fine. A patron must first take the coarse shelf lock, then the fine lock on that same shelf, and only then may place a reservation, and only while the shelf is under its capacity. One member may crash silently at a time; when it does, the system reclaims whatever locks it was holding. A patron takes the coarse shelf lock when it is free. Holding the coarse lock, the patron takes the fine lock. Holding both locks and while the shelf is below capacity, the patron places a reservation. A patron releases both of its locks on a shelf. Any shelf reservation may later be cancelled, lowering that shelf's count. At most one member is crashed at any moment, and it later recovers.

Actions: AcquireCoarse (take the top-level shelf lock), AcquireFine (take the fine lock while holding the coarse lock), Reserve (place a reservation while holding both locks and under capacity), ReleaseLocks (drop both locks a member holds on a shelf), Cancel (remove one reservation from a shelf), Crash (one member crashes silently and its locks are reclaimed), Recover (the crashed member returns).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of reservations on any shelf never exceeds that shelf's fixed capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od1m7p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Flights, Instances, MaxPend

None == "none"
Req == [flight: Flights, inst: Instances]

VARIABLES reg, pending, clearedBy, leader
vars == <<reg, pending, clearedBy, leader>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Flights -> {"open", "cleared"}]
  /\ pending \subseteq Req
  /\ clearedBy \in [Flights -> Instances \union {None}]
  /\ leader \in Instances

Init ==
  /\ reg = [f \in Flights |-> "open"]
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ clearedBy = [f \in Flights |-> None]
  /\ leader \in Instances

\* Either shared instance requests a takeoff clearance for an open flight.
Submit(f, i) ==
  /\ reg[f] = "open"
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < MaxPend
  /\ [flight |-> f, inst |-> i] \notin pending
  /\ pending' = pending \union {[flight |-> f, inst |-> i]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, clearedBy, leader>>

\* The irreversible clearance: CAS the register open -> cleared once, record
\* the clearing instance, and purge every pending request for that flight.
Clear(req) ==
  /\ req \in pending
  /\ reg[req.flight] = "open"
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![req.flight] = "cleared"]
  /\ clearedBy' = [clearedBy EXCEPT ![req.flight] = req.inst]
  /\ pending' = {r \in pending : r.flight # req.flight}
  /\ UNCHANGED leader

\* An instance withdraws one of its pending clearance requests.
Withdraw(req) ==
  /\ req \in pending
  /\ pending' = pending \ {req}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, clearedBy, leader>>

\* The two instances hand off coordination of the shared pool.
Handoff ==
  /\ leader' \in {i \in Instances : i # leader}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, pending, clearedBy>>

Next ==
  \/ \E f \in Flights, i \in Instances : Submit(f, i)
  \/ \E req \in Req : Clear(req)
  \/ \E req \in Req : Withdraw(req)
  \/ Handoff

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStalePending ==
  \A req \in pending : reg[req.flight] = "open"
====

  Instances = {i1, i2}

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStalePending
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator issues takeoff clearances, an irreversible action that must happen at most once per flight. Two independent allocator instances share one pool of flights and coordinate through a compare-and-swap register on each flight. Either instance may request a clearance for a flight whose register is still open. The irreversible clearance compare-and-swaps the register from open to cleared exactly once, records which instance cleared it, and purges every still-pending request for that flight so no stale request survives. An instance may withdraw one of its pending requests. The two instances periodically hand off coordination of the shared pool. Because the register is only ever swapped open-to-cleared and pending requests for a cleared flight are purged, a flight can never be cleared a second time.

Actions: Submit (an instance requests a clearance for an open flight), Clear (the irreversible open-to-cleared CAS that records the clearer and purges that flight's pending requests), Withdraw (an instance drops one pending request), Handoff (the two shared instances swap coordination).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every pending clearance request targets a flight whose register is still open, so no already-cleared flight is ever cleared again.

---- MODULE W4Od2m2p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Robots, MaxRound

None == "none"
Vote == [rnd: 0..MaxRound, val: {"none", "yes", "no"}]

VARIABLES round, vote, members, decided
vars == <<round, vote, members, decided>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
  /\ vote \in [Robots -> Vote]
  /\ members \subseteq Robots
  /\ decided \in {"none", "commit", "abort"}

Init ==
  /\ round = 0
  /\ vote = [r \in Robots |-> [rnd |-> 0, val |-> "none"]]
  /\ members = {}
  /\ decided = "none"

\* Authorize a robot to join the fleet as a voting participant.
Register(r) ==
  /\ r \notin members
  /\ members' = members \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, vote, decided>>

\* Revoke a robot's authorization, also discarding its current vote.
Deregister(r) ==
  /\ r \in members
  /\ members' = members \ {r}
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = [rnd |-> round, val |-> "none"]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, decided>>

\* A (possibly slow) authorized robot casts its vote in the current round.
CastVote(r, v) ==
  /\ decided = "none"
  /\ r \in members
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = [rnd |-> round, val |-> v]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, members, decided>>

\* Once every member has voted this round, the coordinator decides.
Decide ==
  /\ decided = "none"
  /\ members # {}
  /\ \A r \in members : vote[r].rnd = round /\ vote[r].val # "none"
  /\ decided' = IF \A r \in members : vote[r].val = "yes" THEN "commit" ELSE "abort"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, vote, members>>

\* Start the next 2PC round, clearing all stale votes.
NextRound ==
  /\ decided # "none"
  /\ round < MaxRound
  /\ round' = round + 1
  /\ vote' = [r \in Robots |-> [rnd |-> round + 1, val |-> "none"]]
  /\ decided' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED members

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Register(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Deregister(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(r, v)
  \/ Decide
  \/ NextRound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleVote ==
  \A r \in Robots : vote[r].val # "none" => vote[r].rnd = round
====

CONSTANTS
  Robots = {r1, r2}
  MaxRound = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleVote
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet agrees on each task assignment using two-phase commit across the participating robots, numbered by commit round. Only authorized fleet members may vote, and robots may be slow but never fail: a lagging robot eventually casts its vote in the current round. A robot is authorized by registering with the fleet, and its authorization may later be revoked, which also discards its current vote. An authorized robot casts a yes or no vote stamped with the current round; votes may only be cast before a decision is reached. Once every current member has voted in this round, the coordinator decides commit if all voted yes and abort otherwise. Starting the next round advances the round number and clears every vote so that no vote from an earlier round can linger into the new one.

Actions: Register (authorize a robot to vote), Deregister (revoke authorization and discard that robot's vote), CastVote (an authorized robot votes yes or no in the current round), Decide (reach commit or abort once all members have voted this round), NextRound (advance the round and clear all votes).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every vote that currently counts is stamped with the current round, so no stale participant's out-of-date vote is ever counted.

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Registrars, Students, MaxLog

VARIABLES token, enrollLog, status, crashed
vars == <<token, enrollLog, status, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Registrars
  /\ enrollLog \in Seq(Students)
  /\ status \in [Students -> {"idle", "applied", "enrolled"}]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Registrars

Init ==
  /\ token \in Registrars
  /\ enrollLog = << >>
  /\ status = [s \in Students |-> "idle"]
  /\ crashed = {}

\* A student submits a course application.
Apply(s) ==
  /\ status[s] = "idle"
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "applied"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, enrollLog, crashed>>

\* The exclusive-access token advances to the next registrar in the ring.
PassToken(n) ==
  /\ token = n
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ token' \in {m \in Registrars : m # n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrollLog, status, crashed>>

\* The irreversible enrollment: only the token holder finalizes an applicant,
\* moving it applied -> enrolled once and appending it to the roster log.
Enroll(s, n) ==
  /\ token = n
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ status[s] = "applied"
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "enrolled"]
  /\ enrollLog' = Append(enrollLog, s)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, crashed>>

\* A registrar crashes silently; if it held the token, the token is reassigned.
Crash(n) ==
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ crashed' = {n}
  /\ token' = IF token = n THEN CHOOSE m \in Registrars : m # n ELSE token
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrollLog, status>>

\* The crashed registrar recovers.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, enrollLog, status>>

  \/ \E s \in Students : Apply(s)
  \/ \E n \in Registrars : PassToken(n)
  \/ \E s \in Students, n \in Registrars : Enroll(s, n)
  \/ \E n \in Registrars : Crash(n)
  \/ \E n \in Registrars : Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LenBound == Len(enrollLog) <= MaxLog

EnrolledAtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN enrollLog : enrollLog[i] = enrollLog[j] => i = j

---- MODULE W4Od12m2p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Centers, Cap, Batch

VARIABLES inv, pend, votes, phase, slow
vars == <<inv, pend, votes, phase, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ inv \in 0..(Cap + Batch)
  /\ pend \in 0..Batch
  /\ votes \in [Centers -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}
  /\ slow \subseteq Centers

Init ==
  /\ inv = 0
  /\ pend = 0
  /\ votes = [c \in Centers |-> "none"]
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ slow = {}

\* A coordinator prepares a deposit batch and opens a 2PC voting round.
Propose(n) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ n \in 1..Batch
  /\ pend' = n
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ votes' = [c \in Centers |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, slow>>

\* A (possibly slow) center votes on the pending deposit.
Vote(c, v) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, pend, phase, slow>>

\* The deposit commits only if all centers voted yes and it still fits.
Commit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A c \in Centers : votes[c] = "yes"
  /\ inv + pend <= Cap
  /\ inv' = inv + pend
  /\ pend' = 0
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, slow>>

\* The round aborts on any no-vote, on an overflowing batch, or on timeout.
Abort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ pend' = 0
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, votes, slow>>

\* A stored blood unit is withdrawn from the fridge.
Withdraw ==
  /\ inv > 0
  /\ inv' = inv - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pend, votes, phase, slow>>

\* A center becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(c) ==
  /\ c \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, pend, votes, phase>>

\* A slow center resumes normal speed.
Resume(c) ==
  /\ c \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, pend, votes, phase>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in 1..Batch : Propose(n)
  \/ \E c \in Centers, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(c, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Withdraw
  \/ \E c \in Centers : MarkSlow(c)
  \/ \E c \in Centers : Resume(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

InventoryOK == inv <= Cap
====

  Batch = 2

SAFETY PROPERTY: the refrigerator's stored inventory never exceeds its fixed capacity.

CONSTANTS Nodes, Locks, MaxLog

None == "none"

VARIABLES leader, up, pool, wipeLog, done
vars == <<leader, up, pool, wipeLog, done>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \union {None}
  /\ up \subseteq Nodes
  /\ pool \subseteq Locks
  /\ wipeLog \in Seq(Locks)
  /\ done \subseteq Locks

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ up = Nodes
  /\ pool = {}
  /\ wipeLog = << >>
  /\ done = {}

\* A live node with no standing leader is elected coordinator.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \in up
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<up, pool, wipeLog, done>>

\* The current leader fails; the network is left leaderless until failover.
Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ up' = up \ {n}
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, wipeLog, done>>

\* A downed node recovers and rejoins.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \notin up
  /\ up' = up \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, pool, wipeLog, done>>

\* The leader issues a factory-wipe order for a lock into the command pool.
Issue(l) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ l \notin done
  /\ l \notin pool
  /\ pool' = pool \union {l}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, wipeLog, done>>

\* The irreversible wipe: apply any pooled order for a not-yet-wiped lock,
\* appending it to the tamper log exactly once (orders may be reordered).
Apply(l) ==
  /\ l \in pool
  /\ l \notin done
  /\ wipeLog' = Append(wipeLog, l)
  /\ done' = done \union {l}
  /\ pool' = pool \ {l}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

\* A redundant reordered order for an already-wiped lock is discarded.
Drop(l) ==
  /\ l \in pool
  /\ l \in done
  /\ pool' = pool \ {l}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, wipeLog, done>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Issue(l)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Apply(l)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Drop(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LenBound == Len(wipeLog) <= MaxLog

WipedAtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN wipeLog : wipeLog[i] = wipeLog[j] => i = j
====

CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {n1, n2}
  Locks = {l1, l2}
  MaxLog = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
CONSTRAINT LenBound
INVARIANT WipedAtMostOnce
nl:
A smart-home door lock network can factory-wipe a lost lock, an irreversible action that must happen at most once per lock. A leader elected among the hub nodes, with failover, issues wipe orders, and because the network reorders messages, pooled orders may be applied in any order and a lock may receive a duplicate order. A live hub with no standing leader is elected coordinator. The current leader may fail, leaving the network leaderless until a new leader is elected; a downed hub may later recover. The leader issues a factory-wipe order for a not-yet-wiped lock into the command pool. The irreversible wipe applies any pooled order for a lock that has not yet been wiped, appending the lock to the tamper log exactly once and marking it done. A redundant reordered order for an already-wiped lock is simply discarded.

Actions: Elect (a live hub with no leader becomes coordinator), Fail (the leader fails and the network becomes leaderless), Recover (a downed hub rejoins), Issue (the leader adds a wipe order to the pool), Apply (the irreversible wipe of a not-yet-wiped lock, appended to the tamper log once), Drop (discard a redundant order for an already-wiped lock).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no lock ever appears more than once in the tamper log, so the irreversible factory-wipe happens at most once per lock.

---- MODULE W4Od2m8p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Zones, Robots, MaxCap

None == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, crit, cap, staged
vars == <<coarse, crit, cap, staged>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in [Zones -> Robots \union {None}]
  /\ crit \subseteq Robots
  /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ staged \subseteq Robots

Init ==
  /\ coarse = [z \in Zones |-> None]
  /\ crit = {}
  /\ cap = 0
  /\ staged = {}

\* The staging-area capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
SetCapacity(k) ==
  /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ k # cap
  /\ cap' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, crit, staged>>

\* A robot enters the staging area while there is room under current capacity.
EnterStaging(r) ==
  /\ r \notin staged
  /\ Cardinality(staged) < cap
  /\ staged' = staged \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, crit, cap>>

\* A staged robot takes a zone's coarse lock (the top of the hierarchy).
AcquireCoarse(z, r) ==
  /\ r \in staged
  /\ coarse[z] = None
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![z] = r]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crit, cap, staged>>

\* A robot holding some coarse lock enters the single critical resource,
\* permitted only while the resource is free.
EnterCrit(r) ==
  /\ \E z \in Zones : coarse[z] = r
  /\ crit = {}
  /\ crit' = crit \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, cap, staged>>

\* A robot leaves the critical resource and releases all it holds.
ExitCrit(r) ==
  /\ r \in crit
  /\ crit' = crit \ {r}
  /\ coarse' = [z \in Zones |-> IF coarse[z] = r THEN None ELSE coarse[z]]
  /\ staged' = staged \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED cap

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCapacity(k)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : EnterStaging(r)
  \/ \E z \in Zones, r \in Robots : AcquireCoarse(z, r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : EnterCrit(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : ExitCrit(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
  \A r1, r2 \in crit : r1 = r2
====

  Zones = {z1, z2}
  Robots = {rr1, rr2}
  MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet guards a single shared critical resource (a charging bay) so that only one robot ever uses it at a time, reaching it through a hierarchy of locks: a coarse per-zone maneuvering lock taken first, then the fine lock on the shared resource itself. The size of the staging area changes at runtime as floor space is reallocated. The staging capacity is reconfigured to any value at runtime. A robot enters the staging area only while the number of staged robots is below the current capacity. A staged robot takes the coarse lock of some zone when that zone's lock is free. A robot that holds a coarse lock may enter the shared critical resource, but only while the resource is currently free. A robot leaves the critical resource, releasing every coarse lock it holds and leaving the staging area.

Actions: SetCapacity (reconfigure the staging capacity at runtime), EnterStaging (a robot joins staging while under capacity), AcquireCoarse (a staged robot takes a zone's coarse lock), EnterCrit (a coarse-lock holder enters the critical resource only when it is free), ExitCrit (a robot leaves the resource and releases its locks and staging slot).

SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one robot ever occupies the shared critical resource at the same time.

CONSTANTS Nodes, Levels, Cap

  /\ book \in [Levels -> 0..(Cap + 1)]
  /\ slow \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ up = Nodes
  /\ book = [l \in Levels |-> 0]
  /\ slow = {}

\* A live node with no standing leader is elected auction coordinator.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \in up
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<up, book, slow>>

\* The current leader fails; the auction is leaderless until failover.
Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ up' = up \ {n}
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<book, slow>>

\* A downed node recovers and rejoins.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \notin up
  /\ up' = up \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, book, slow>>

\* Only the leader admits an order to a price level, and only under capacity.

  /\ leader # None

  /\ book' = [book EXCEPT ![l] = book[l] - 1]

\* A node becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(n) ==
  /\ n \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, book>>

\* A slow node resumes normal speed.
Resume(n) ==
  /\ n \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {n}

  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
  \/ \E l \in Levels : Admit(l)

  Nodes = {n1, n2}
  Levels = {lo, hi}
  Cap = 2

NEXT Next

nl:
A stock exchange opening auction builds an order book with a bounded depth at each price level, coordinated by an elected leader with failover. Participants may be slow but never fail: a lagging participant eventually acts and its orders are still processed. A live node with no standing leader is elected auction coordinator. The current leader may fail, leaving the auction leaderless until a new leader is elected; a downed node may later recover and rejoin. Only the leader admits an order to a price level, and only while that level is below its capacity. A resting order at a price level may be matched, removing it from the book. A node may become slow (lagging) and later resume normal speed, but it never fails.

---- MODULE W4Od2m7p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cells, Robots, Admin, MaxVer, MaxAtt

None == "none"
Att == [cell: Cells, who: Robots, seen: 0..MaxVer]

VARIABLES owner, ver, members, attempts
vars == <<owner, ver, members, attempts>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in [Cells -> Robots \union {Admin, None}]
  /\ ver \in [Cells -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ members \subseteq Robots
  /\ attempts \subseteq Att

Init ==
  /\ owner = [c \in Cells |-> None]
  /\ ver = [c \in Cells |-> 0]
  /\ members = {}
  /\ attempts = {}

\* A robot is authorized to act on cells.
Authorize(r) ==
  /\ r \notin members
  /\ members' = members \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, attempts>>

\* Authorization is revoked and the robot is stripped from any cell it owns.
Revoke(r) ==
  /\ r \in members
  /\ members' = members \ {r}
  /\ owner' = [c \in Cells |-> IF owner[c] = r THEN None ELSE owner[c]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, attempts>>

\* An authorized robot proposes a CAS on a cell, recording the seen version.
Propose(c, r) ==
  /\ r \in members
  /\ Cardinality(attempts) < MaxAtt
  /\ attempts' = attempts \union {[cell |-> c, who |-> r, seen |-> ver[c]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, members>>

\* The CAS commits only if the version is unchanged, the cell is free, and
\* the proposer is still an authorized member.
Commit(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ ver[a.cell] = a.seen
  /\ owner[a.cell] = None
  /\ a.who \in members
  /\ ver[a.cell] < MaxVer
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![a.cell] = a.who]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![a.cell] = ver[a.cell] + 1]
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED members

\* A stale attempt whose observed version has changed is dropped.
Stale(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ ver[a.cell] # a.seen
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, members>>

\* The privileged admin override seizes a free cell, bypassing membership.
AdminSeize(c) ==
  /\ owner[c] = None
  /\ ver[c] < MaxVer
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![c] = Admin]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![c] = ver[c] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<members, attempts>>

\* The current owner releases a cell.
Release(c) ==
  /\ owner[c] # None
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![c] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, members, attempts>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Authorize(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Revoke(r)
  \/ \E c \in Cells, r \in Robots : Propose(c, r)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Commit(a)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Stale(a)
  \/ \E c \in Cells : AdminSeize(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cells : Release(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OwnerAuthorized ==
  \A c \in Cells : owner[c] # None => (owner[c] \in members \/ owner[c] = Admin)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cells = {c1, c2}
  Robots = {rr1, rr2}
  Admin = adm
  MaxVer = 2
  MaxAtt = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OwnerAuthorized
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet acts on grid cells through compare-and-swap registers, and only authorized robots — or a privileged admin override — may take ownership of a cell. Each cell carries a version; a robot's proposal records the version it observed so a stale proposal can be rejected. A robot is authorized by joining the member set, and its authorization may be revoked, which also strips it from any cell it currently owns. An authorized robot proposes a compare-and-swap on a cell, recording the observed version. The proposal commits only if the version is unchanged, the cell is free, and the proposer is still an authorized member; committing takes ownership and advances the version. A proposal whose observed version has since changed is dropped as stale. The privileged admin override may seize any free cell directly, bypassing the membership check, since the admin is trusted by definition. The current owner may release a cell.

Actions: Authorize (grant a robot membership), Revoke (revoke membership and strip the robot from any cell it owns), Propose (an authorized robot proposes a CAS recording the observed version), Commit (apply the CAS only when version, freeness, and membership all still hold), Stale (drop a proposal whose version has changed), AdminSeize (the privileged admin takes a free cell, bypassing membership), Release (the owner frees a cell).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every owned cell is held either by a currently authorized robot or by the privileged admin, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever holds a cell.

---- MODULE W4Od10m8p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks, Lines

None == "none"

VARIABLES held, coarse, active, pending
vars == <<held, coarse, active, pending>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ held \in [Trains -> SUBSET Blocks]
  /\ coarse \in [Lines -> Trains \union {None}]
  /\ active \subseteq Blocks
  /\ pending \in [Trains -> SUBSET Blocks]

Init ==
  /\ held = [t \in Trains |-> {}]
  /\ coarse = [ln \in Lines |-> None]
  /\ active = {}
  /\ pending = [t \in Trains |-> {}]

\* A signalling block is brought into service (capacity grows at runtime).
Activate(b) ==
  /\ b \notin active
  /\ active' = active \union {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, coarse, pending>>

\* A block is taken out of service, releasing it from every train.
Deactivate(b) ==
  /\ b \in active
  /\ active' = active \ {b}
  /\ held' = [t \in Trains |-> held[t] \ {b}]
  /\ pending' = [t \in Trains |-> pending[t] \ {b}]
  /\ UNCHANGED coarse

\* A train takes a line's coarse lock (the top of the hierarchy).
AcquireCoarse(ln, t) ==
  /\ coarse[ln] = None
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![ln] = t]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, active, pending>>

\* A train records intent to occupy an in-service block.
Request(t, b) ==
  /\ b \in active
  /\ b \notin pending[t]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![t] = pending[t] \union {b}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, coarse, active>>

\* A train occupies a requested block only while holding a coarse lock, the
\* block is in service, and no other train already holds it.
Occupy(t, b) ==
  /\ b \in pending[t]
  /\ \E ln \in Lines : coarse[ln] = t
  /\ b \in active
  /\ \A t2 \in Trains : b \notin held[t2]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![t] = held[t] \union {b}]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![t] = pending[t] \ {b}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, active>>

\* A train releases a block it holds.
ReleaseBlock(t, b) ==
  /\ b \in held[t]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![t] = held[t] \ {b}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, active, pending>>

\* A train releases a line's coarse lock.
ReleaseCoarse(ln, t) ==
  /\ coarse[ln] = t
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![ln] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, active, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Activate(b)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Deactivate(b)
  \/ \E ln \in Lines, t \in Trains : AcquireCoarse(ln, t)
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Request(t, b)
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Occupy(t, b)
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : ReleaseBlock(t, b)
  \/ \E ln \in Lines, t \in Trains : ReleaseCoarse(ln, t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleOccupancy ==
  \A t1, t2 \in Trains : t1 # t2 => (held[t1] \cap held[t2] = {})
====
nl:
A subway signalling block system allocates track blocks to trains so that no block is ever occupied by two trains at once, protecting each acquisition with a lock hierarchy: a coarse line lock taken first, then occupation of the fine block. The set of in-service blocks changes at runtime as segments are opened and closed for maintenance. A block is brought into service, growing capacity; a block taken out of service is released from every train that holds or wants it. A train takes a line's coarse lock when it is free. A train records intent to occupy an in-service block. A train actually occupies a requested block only while it holds a coarse lock, the block is in service, and no other train already holds that block. A train releases a block it holds, and releases a line's coarse lock.

Actions: Activate (bring a block into service), Deactivate (take a block out of service and release it from all trains), AcquireCoarse (take a line's coarse lock), Request (record intent to occupy an in-service block), Occupy (occupy a requested block while holding the coarse lock, the block is active, and no train holds it), ReleaseBlock (free a held block), ReleaseCoarse (free a line's coarse lock).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no track block is ever held by two different trains at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od17m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Chutes, Bags, Instances

None == "none"

VARIABLES owner, assigned, prop, votes, phase
vars == <<owner, assigned, prop, votes, phase>>

Proposals == [bag: Bags, chute: Chutes]

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in [Chutes -> Bags \union {None}]
  /\ assigned \in [Bags -> Chutes \union {None}]
  /\ prop \in Proposals \union {None}
  /\ votes \in [Instances -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}

Init ==
  /\ owner = [c \in Chutes |-> None]
  /\ assigned = [b \in Bags |-> None]
  /\ prop = None
  /\ votes = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
  /\ phase = "idle"

\* An instance proposes binding a free bag to a free chute, opening a round.
Propose(bg, ch) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ owner[ch] = None
  /\ assigned[bg] = None
  /\ prop' = [bag |-> bg, chute |-> ch]
  /\ votes' = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, assigned>>

\* Either shared instance votes on the open proposal.
Vote(i, v) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, assigned, prop, phase>>

\* The binding commits only if both instances voted yes and both endpoints
\* are still free, wiring the two back-pointers together.
Commit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A i \in Instances : votes[i] = "yes"
  /\ owner[prop.chute] = None
  /\ assigned[prop.bag] = None
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop.chute] = prop.bag]
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![prop.bag] = prop.chute]
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes>>

\* The round aborts on any no-vote or a now-conflicting endpoint.
Abort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, assigned, prop, votes>>

\* A bag is unassigned, freeing both it and its chute.
Unassign(bg) ==
  /\ assigned[bg] # None
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![assigned[bg]] = None]
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![bg] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes, phase>>

Next ==
  \/ \E bg \in Bags, ch \in Chutes : Propose(bg, ch)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(i, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E bg \in Bags : Unassign(bg)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BindingCoherent ==
  \A bg \in Bags : assigned[bg] # None => owner[assigned[bg]] = bg
====
nl:
An airport baggage router binds bags to delivery chutes using two-phase commit, with two independent router instances sharing one pool of chutes. Each chute records the bag it holds and each bag records its chute, and no chute may be bound to two bags. An instance proposes binding a currently free bag to a currently free chute, opening a commit round and clearing the votes. Either shared instance votes yes or no on the open proposal. The binding commits only if both instances voted yes and both the chute and the bag are still free, wiring the two back-pointers to each other. The round aborts on any no-vote or if an endpoint is no longer free, discarding the proposal. A bag may be unassigned, which frees both the bag and its chute.

Actions: Propose (an instance proposes a free-bag-to-free-chute binding and opens a round), Vote (a shared instance votes yes or no), Commit (bind both back-pointers when both instances agree and both endpoints are free), Abort (discard the proposal on a no-vote or conflict), Unassign (release a bag and its chute).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a bag records a chute, that chute records the very same bag, so no chute is ever double-allocated to two bags.

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Currencies, Instances, Cap, Batch

VARIABLES settled, propCur, propAmt, votes, phase

  /\ propCur \in Currencies
  /\ propAmt \in 0..Batch
  /\ votes \in [Instances -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}

  /\ settled = [c \in Currencies |-> 0]
  /\ propCur \in Currencies
  /\ propAmt = 0
  /\ votes = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
  /\ phase = "idle"

\* An instance proposes settling a batch amount in some currency.
Propose(cur, n) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ n \in 1..Batch
  /\ propCur' = cur
  /\ propAmt' = n
  /\ votes' = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ UNCHANGED settled

Vote(i, v) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<settled, propCur, propAmt, phase>>

\* still fits within the currency's settlement cap.

  /\ \A i \in Instances : votes[i] = "yes"
  /\ settled[propCur] + propAmt <= Cap
  /\ settled' = [settled EXCEPT ![propCur] = settled[propCur] + propAmt]
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<propCur, propAmt, votes>>

\* The round aborts on a no-vote or an amount that would breach the cap.

  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<settled, propCur, propAmt, votes>>

  /\ settled[cur] > 0
  /\ settled' = [settled EXCEPT ![cur] = settled[cur] - 1]

Next ==
  \/ \E cur \in Currencies, n \in 1..Batch : Propose(cur, n)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(i, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E cur \in Currencies : Reverse(cur)

---- MODULE W4Od18m7p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Locks, Instances, Total, MaxVer, MaxAtt

Att == [lock: Locks, seen: 0..MaxVer, inst: Instances, dir: {"load", "unload"}]

RECURSIVE FoldSum(_, _)
FoldSum(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + FoldSum(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES credit, vault, ver, attempts
vars == <<credit, vault, ver, attempts>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ credit \in [Locks -> 0..Total]
  /\ vault \in 0..Total
  /\ ver \in [Locks -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ attempts \subseteq Att

Init ==
  /\ credit = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
  /\ vault = Total
  /\ ver = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
  /\ attempts = {}

\* An instance proposes a CAS to move one credit from the vault into a lock.
ProposeLoad(l, i) ==
  /\ Cardinality(attempts) < MaxAtt
  /\ vault > 0
  /\ attempts' = attempts \union {[lock |-> l, seen |-> ver[l], inst |-> i, dir |-> "load"]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credit, vault, ver>>

\* An instance proposes a CAS to move one credit from a lock to the vault.
ProposeUnload(l, i) ==
  /\ Cardinality(attempts) < MaxAtt
  /\ credit[l] > 0
  /\ attempts' = attempts \union {[lock |-> l, seen |-> ver[l], inst |-> i, dir |-> "unload"]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credit, vault, ver>>

\* The load CAS commits only if the observed version still matches.
CommitLoad(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ a.dir = "load"
  /\ ver[a.lock] = a.seen
  /\ vault > 0
  /\ vault' = vault - 1
  /\ credit' = [credit EXCEPT ![a.lock] = credit[a.lock] + 1]
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED ver

\* The unload CAS commits only if the observed version still matches.
CommitUnload(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ a.dir = "unload"
  /\ ver[a.lock] = a.seen
  /\ credit[a.lock] > 0
  /\ credit' = [credit EXCEPT ![a.lock] = credit[a.lock] - 1]
  /\ vault' = vault + 1
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED ver

\* An attempt whose observed version has since changed is dropped.
Stale(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ ver[a.lock] # a.seen
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credit, vault, ver>>

\* A competing write bumps a lock's version, staling open attempts.
Bump(l) ==
  /\ ver[l] < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![l] = ver[l] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credit, vault, attempts>>

Next ==
  \/ \E l \in Locks, i \in Instances : ProposeLoad(l, i)
  \/ \E l \in Locks, i \in Instances : ProposeUnload(l, i)
  \/ \E a \in Att : CommitLoad(a)
  \/ \E a \in Att : CommitUnload(a)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Stale(a)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Bump(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CreditsConserved ==
  FoldSum(credit, Locks) + vault = Total
====

CONSTANTS
  Locks = {l1, l2}
  Instances = {i1, i2}
  Total = 2
  MaxVer = 2
  MaxAtt = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CreditsConserved
nl:
A smart-home door lock network circulates a fixed pool of access credits between a central vault and the individual locks, using compare-and-swap registers to coordinate two independent controller instances that share the pool. Every credit is always either in the vault or held by a lock; none are created or destroyed. An instance proposes a compare-and-swap to move one credit from the vault into a lock, recording the lock's observed version. An instance likewise proposes a CAS to move one credit from a lock back to the vault. A load CAS commits only if the lock's observed version still matches, moving one credit vault-to-lock. An unload CAS commits only if the version still matches, moving one credit lock-to-vault. An attempt whose observed version has since changed is dropped. A competing write may bump a lock's version, staling any open attempt against it.

Actions: ProposeLoad (an instance proposes a vault-to-lock CAS recording the observed version), ProposeUnload (an instance proposes a lock-to-vault CAS), CommitLoad (apply a vault-to-lock move when the version still matches), CommitUnload (apply a lock-to-vault move when the version still matches), Stale (drop an attempt whose version changed), Bump (a competing write advances a lock's version).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of access credits across the vault and all locks is always exactly the fixed pool the network started with.

---- MODULE W4Od6m0p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Requests, Cars, MaxVer, MaxAtt, MaxLog

Att == [req: Requests, seen: 0..MaxVer]

VARIABLES ver, served, dispatchLog, attempts, slow
vars == <<ver, served, dispatchLog, attempts, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in [Requests -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ served \subseteq Requests
  /\ dispatchLog \in Seq(Requests)
  /\ attempts \subseteq Att
  /\ slow \subseteq Cars

Init ==
  /\ ver = [r \in Requests |-> 0]
  /\ served = {}
  /\ dispatchLog = << >>
  /\ attempts = {}
  /\ slow = {}

\* Optimistically propose serving a not-yet-served hall call, recording the
\* version observed so a competing update can be detected before dispatch.
Propose(r) ==
  /\ Cardinality(attempts) < MaxAtt
  /\ r \notin served
  /\ attempts' = attempts \union {[req |-> r, seen |-> ver[r]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, served, dispatchLog, slow>>

\* A competing controller update bumps a call's version, staling attempts.
Bump(r) ==
  /\ r \notin served
  /\ ver[r] < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = ver[r] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<served, dispatchLog, attempts, slow>>

\* The irreversible dispatch: fires once for a not-yet-served call whose
\* observed version still matches, appending it to the dispatch log.
Dispatch(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ ver[a.req] = a.seen
  /\ a.req \notin served
  /\ served' = served \union {a.req}
  /\ dispatchLog' = Append(dispatchLog, a.req)
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, slow>>

\* An attempt whose observed version has since changed is dropped and retried.
Retry(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ ver[a.req] # a.seen
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, served, dispatchLog, slow>>

\* An elevator car becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(c) ==
  /\ c \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, served, dispatchLog, attempts>>

\* A slow car resumes normal speed.
Resume(c) ==
  /\ c \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, served, dispatchLog, attempts>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Requests : Propose(r)
  \/ \E r \in Requests : Bump(r)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Dispatch(a)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Retry(a)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : MarkSlow(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Resume(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LenBound == Len(dispatchLog) <= MaxLog

DispatchedAtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN dispatchLog : dispatchLog[i] = dispatchLog[j] => i = j
====

CONSTANTS
  Requests = {q1, q2}
  Cars = {ca1, ca2}
  MaxVer = 2
  MaxAtt = 1
  MaxLog = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
CONSTRAINT LenBound
INVARIANT DispatchedAtMostOnce
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper dispatches a car to each hall call, an irreversible action that must happen at most once per call. Controllers coordinate through optimistic locking with retry: each call carries a version, and a proposal records the version it observed so a competing update can be detected before the dispatch commits. Cars may be slow but never fail: a lagging car still eventually completes its run. A controller optimistically proposes serving a not-yet-served call, recording the call's current version. A competing controller update may bump a call's version, staling any open proposal against it. The irreversible dispatch fires only for a call that has not yet been served and whose observed version still matches, marking it served and appending it to the append-only dispatch log. A proposal whose observed version has since changed is dropped and would be retried. A car may become slow and later resume, but it never fails.

Actions: Propose (optimistically propose serving a call, recording the observed version), Bump (a competing update advances a call's version, staling proposals), Dispatch (the irreversible one-time dispatch of a not-yet-served call whose version still matches, appended to the log), Retry (drop a stale proposal), MarkSlow (a car starts lagging), Resume (a slow car catches up).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no hall call ever appears more than once in the dispatch log, so a car is dispatched to any call at most once.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Quorum, MaxRound

VARIABLES round, members, approvals, slow
vars == <<round, members, approvals, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
  /\ members \subseteq Banks
  /\ approvals \subseteq Banks
  /\ slow \subseteq Banks

Init ==
  /\ round = 0
  /\ members = {}
  /\ approvals = {}
  /\ slow = {}

\* A bank is authorized to participate in settlement quorums.
Register(b) ==
  /\ b \notin members
  /\ members' = members \union {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, approvals, slow>>

\* A bank's authorization is revoked; any approval it cast is withdrawn.
Deregister(b) ==
  /\ b \in members
  /\ members' = members \ {b}
  /\ approvals' = approvals \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, slow>>

\* Only an authorized bank may approve the current settlement action.
Approve(b) ==
  /\ b \in members
  /\ b \notin approvals
  /\ approvals' = approvals \union {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, members, slow>>

\* Once a quorum of authorized approvals is reached, the action executes and
\* the tally is cleared for the next action.
Commit ==
  /\ Cardinality(approvals) >= Quorum
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, members, slow>>

\* The current action is abandoned; the round advances and stale approvals
\* are cleared so no earlier round's vote can carry over.
NewRound ==
  /\ round < MaxRound
  /\ round' = round + 1
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<members, slow>>

\* A bank becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(b) ==
  /\ b \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, members, approvals>>

\* A slow bank resumes normal speed.
Resume(b) ==
  /\ b \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, members, approvals>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Register(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Deregister(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Approve(b)
  \/ Commit
  \/ NewRound
  \/ \E b \in Banks : MarkSlow(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Resume(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ApprovalsAuthorized ==
  approvals \subseteq members
====

CONSTANTS
  Banks = {bk1, bk2, bk3}
  Quorum = 2
  MaxRound = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ApprovalsAuthorized
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch approves each settlement action by quorum voting among the participating banks. Only authorized banks may approve, and banks may be slow but never fail: a lagging bank still eventually casts its approval in the current round. A bank is authorized by registering, and its authorization may be revoked, which also withdraws any approval it had cast. Only an authorized bank may approve the current settlement action, and only once. Once a quorum of authorized approvals is reached, the action executes and the approval tally is cleared for the next action. The current action may instead be abandoned by advancing the round, which clears the tally so no earlier round's approval carries over. A bank may become slow and later resume normal speed, but it never fails.

Actions: Register (authorize a bank), Deregister (revoke authorization and withdraw that bank's approval), Approve (an authorized bank approves the current action once), Commit (execute the action once a quorum of approvals is reached and clear the tally), NewRound (abandon the current action, advance the round, and clear stale approvals), MarkSlow (a bank starts lagging), Resume (a slow bank catches up).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every approval in the current tally comes from a currently authorized bank, so no unauthorized or stale participant's approval ever counts toward a quorum.
